committeeRoster.dateBasis: Indexed official roster retrieved on this date; not a certified historical snapshot of the reading date.
committeeRoster.absencePolicy: Not listed in the recovered numbered roster is not certified non-membership: ex-officio roles and unresolved identities are separate.
committeeRoster.leadershipRoleScope: Verified leadership identities, including the recovered Deputy Speakers section; not a complete roster of all House positions. Roles are descriptive and do not affect allocation attribution or ranking. Party-list identities have no geographic district totals.
committeeRoster.leadershipDateBasis: Current indexed roster retrieved 2026-10-11; not a certified historical roster at the HGAB reading.
committeeRoster.blocPolicy: Majority/minority is copied only from the official committee role. Chair and vice-chair roles alone do not establish bloc. Minority is not a certified opposition label.

bicam.context: House statement discusses opening budget bicam proceedings; it does not name an appointed delegation. No committee member is inferred to be a conferee.
